obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page background, hero canvas, base surface — carries a warm umber undertone rather than neutral black so the page reads as lit, not void

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card surface, elevated panels, nav bar, footer — one step lighter than canvas to create depth without color shift

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Higher elevation surfaces, input fields, nested cards — second step in the surface stack

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary surface, hover states on dark panels, subtle dividers in dense contexts

stone.$description: Stone — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Muted icon color, secondary metadata text, inactive stroke

pebble.$description: Pebble — Tertiary text, captions, supporting metadata

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary text, link hover, subtle icon stroke

fog.$description: Fog — Primary text, headings, nav links — the dominant text color across the interface

bone.$description: Bone — High-emphasis text, button labels on dark fills, hero headline accent

pure.$description: Pure — Maximum contrast text, logo wordmark, high-priority callouts

pilot-gold.$description: Pilot Gold — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

circuit-green.$description: Circuit Green — Decorative geometry only — floating triangle/quarter-circle accents in hero and section backgrounds; never used on buttons or states

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

circularxx.$description: Workhorse sans for body, nav, buttons, cards, and form labels. Weight 400 is the UI default; 500 for button text and emphasized labels; 300 appears in the logotype wordmark. The slight negative tracking (-0.019em) tightens the humanist forms into a more instrumented feel.

whyte.$description: Display face for hero headlines and section titles. Weight 300 at 72px with -0.056em tracking is the signature move: anti-convention for a dev tool, where most competitors use 700-800. The whisper-weight display creates authority through restraint — the type breathes instead of pushing.

whyte-inktrap.$description: Mid-size headings (30-60px) where the inktrap terminals prevent thin strokes from closing up at smaller display sizes. Bridges the gap between the light display weight and readable mid-size headings.

circularxxmono.$description: Code snippets, monospaced labels, technical metadata, version strings. Limited to 12-18px — always auxiliary, never structural.
